## Generated-map limitations

- Symbol source: **repomix (tree-sitter signatures)**
- Files with many public symbols list only their first 12; the rest are in `.agent/navigation.json`.
- Only Git-tracked files are indexed; untracked and ignored files are invisible to this map.
- This map answers "where should I look?". For current issues, pull requests and CI state, use the Gitea MCP server.
